caseInfo.summary:
Investigation into a suspected smuggling and money-laundering network operating through Harbor Line Trading Ltd. Focus on the primary subject (code name NIGHTJAR), his associates, vehicles, digital footprint and payment flows.

All names, numbers and places in this file are fictional sample data.
caseInfo.assessment: Hale is assessed with moderate-to-high confidence to coordinate night-time shipments from the quay warehouse. Kovac probably manages the payment side. Recommend continued surveillance and a financial production order for the exchange account.
